scores.justification: The design documentation is comprehensive, mapping 26 use cases to functional requirements and a robust MVVM architecture. The main weakness is the lack of explicit justification for choosing Cloud Firestore's 'Spark' plan despite the 700KB limitation which impacts core reel/video functionality.
requires verifiable evidence: marked in a live session

The testing report is exceptionally detailed, covering five levels including security rules and live Firebase end-to-end tests. A minor gap is the absence of performance or stress testing for the third-party holiday API integration, though coverage is high at 88.4%.
